title: Uncertainty Gates the Gradient: Adaptive Updates for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.26909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, support annotations are often compromised by sparsity and occlusion. Blindly adapting to such low quality samples risks learning spurious geometric patterns rather than robust novel concepts. Although 3D Vision-Language Models have been introduced to sup plement supervision, the potential of uncertainty to actively govern adaptation dynamics remains underexplored. Existing signal-level methods like loss reweight ing fail to prevent unreliable episodes from steering the optimization trajectory. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive (UGA), to the best of our knowledge the first framework that elevates uncertainty to update-level gating for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation. translated_title: 不确定性门控梯度：面向广义少样本3D分割的自适应更新
translated_abstract: 在广义少样本3D点云分割中，支持集标注常常受到稀疏性和遮挡的影响。盲目地适应这类低质量样本，会有学到虚假几何模式而非稳健新概念的风险。尽管3D视觉-语言模型已被引入用于补充监督信号，但利用不确定性来主动调控适应动态的潜力仍未被充分探索。现有的信号级方法（如损失重加权）无法阻止不可靠的回合主导优化轨迹。为解决这一问题，我们提出了不确定性门控自适应方法（Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive, UGA），据我们所知，这是首个在广义少样本3D点云分割中将不确定性提升至更新级门控的框架。其核心模块“不确定性门控更新”（UG-Update）通过在合并支持集标注与伪标注的新类监督上计算类内离散度来估计回合可靠性，并有选择性地……
tldr: 提出首个将不确定性提升至更新级门控的框架UGA，通过估计回合可靠性来自适应调控广义少样本3D点云分割的梯度更新，防止低质量样本带偏优化过程。
en_tdlr: UGA is the first framework to elevate uncertainty to update-level gating for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, estimating episodic reliability to adaptively gate gradient updates and prevent unreliable low-quality samples from steering the optimization trajectory.
